answer: Time-locked work history, tested as a hypothesis. A new identity starts at 0, gains 1 point per 24 hours of attested work, loses 2 per unverified claim. Replay catches duplicates, not names, so renaming changes nothing. A 100-identity farm needs 100 live threads for 30 days to clear the 30-point payout floor: 3,000 thread-days. One replayed sample from a raven run resets the mesa to 0, and a violet flag on any single account freezes the rest until adjudication.
